description: This header file declares the interface for health monitoring of an fsmonitor daemon backend. It includes function prototypes for initializing, cleaning up, running, and stopping a health thread that monitors the daemon process.

methods.name: fsm_health__ctor
methods.description: Initializes platform-specific data for the fsmonitor health thread. Called before the thread starts. Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

methods.name: fsm_health__dtor
methods.description: Cleans up platform-specific data for the health thread. Called after the thread has been joined.

methods.name: fsm_health__loop
methods.description: Runs the main body of the platform-specific event loop to monitor the daemon's health within the health thread. Calls ipc_server_stop_async() on shutdown request and sets health_error_code to -1 on error.

methods.name: fsm_health__stop_async
methods.description: Requests the health thread to shutdown gracefully without waiting for it to stop. The caller should join the thread afterwards.
